title: gypsophila thessalus
intro: Gypsophila thessalus, commonly known as the Serbian tea or the Greek featherflower, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Polemoniaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, inflammation, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Gypsophila thessalus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
